response.sql: WITH color_invoiced AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') as color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) as total_invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')), total_all AS (SELECT SUM(derived_total_cost) as grand_total FROM Invoice_Line_Items), color_with_share AS (SELECT ci.color, ci.total_invoiced, ci.total_invoiced / ta.grand_total as share FROM color_invoiced ci CROSS JOIN total_all ta), avg_per_color AS (SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) as avg_invoiced FROM color_invoiced), above_average_colors AS (SELECT cws.color, cws.total_invoiced, cws.share, cws.total_invoiced - apc.avg_invoiced as above_average FROM color_with_share cws CROSS JOIN avg_per_color apc WHERE cws.total_invoiced > apc.avg_invoiced) SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) as avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(above_average) as avg_above_average FROM above_average_colors
